limitations.note: The agent fixed the Gray decoder’s low-bit XOR but also replaced the original registered feedback stages with combinational logic and a toggle enable; the rewrite passed all graded samples, but the reference fix preserves those stages.

limitations.quote: correct that operand and preserve the register boundaries and reset behavior

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire verification script before simulation, so the agent had to resubmit it with a different cleanup command.
